07cc1867185c2a7c0ceb4b3d317e73710a17c91a, renamed for the Catwalk corpus:

The STEP is a mesh-derived AP214 faceted export of the retained millimeter STL,
not original manufacturer CAD. Its FILE_NAME identifies the Jumper faceted
B-rep converter. The public producer's conversion source is pinned here:
https://github.com/manifoldor/jumper-replica/blob/07cc1867185c2a7c0ceb4b3d317e73710a17c91a/tools/jumper_faceted_step.py
Catwalk does not modify either geometry file.

Jumper Replica

Includes selected Jumper source materials and derived geometry.
Jumper: Copyright 2026 KingKong Robotics. Apache License 2.0.
Source: https://github.com/KingKongRobotics/jumper
Pinned commit: 61d065219fca767f3142c8f10aff59eae5a5a004

Changes in this project: connected-component extraction, meter-to-millimeter
conversion, vertex-only seam welding, faceted STEP conversion, rigid print
orientations, assembly explosion translations, annotations and documentation.
All changed/generated files are catalogued in provenance/artifact_manifest.json.

New project scripts, documentation, annotations and renders are explicitly
licensed under Apache-2.0. This project is independent and does not imply
manufacturer endorsement. External references retain their own terms.
